notes.title: Version 1.3.0 Update Information
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40995878/9784f4e7739ca77781ad60da798ab3c89b3a5588.jpg[/img]

Hello from Waku Waku Games.

As at 9-Dec 2022, we've released an update to The Hundred Year Kingdom that fixes bugs and adjusts the balance of the game. We apologize for the inconvenience, but would appreciate it if you installed the update.

The changes and fixes made in this update are as follows:

[b][Version 1.3.0 Patch note][/b]

[u][b]Addition of two new worlds[/b][/u]

[b]A world of fire and ice.[/b]
New terrain, volcanoes and ice, and tundra have been added to this world.
Make full use of the newly added terrain to develop your civilization.

[b]A World Without an Oracle[/b]
This is a world where the blessings of the oracle priestess are no longer available.
Your skills as a creator will be put to the test.


[u][b]Bug fixes:[/b][/u]
/ Fixed a bug in which some buttons could be pressed while the menu was open.
/ Fixed a bug that the game can be resumed when returning to the title in the fantasy world.

Upon applying this update, the game version will be "1.3.0".
Thanks for playing, and for your cooperation.

notes.title: Update Information (28-June)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40995878/9784f4e7739ca77781ad60da798ab3c89b3a5588.jpg[/img]

Hi, everybody! This is Waku Waku Games.

An update with a new world was released on June 28, 2022.
Please take a few minutes to apply the update.

The following items have been updated:

A new "World of Agriculture" full of food has been added.
Welcome to the world of marble and iron, "The World of Mines" has been added.

As the name suggests, each world is biased toward either food or production.

In "World of Agriculture," even novice players can create a successful civilization with relative ease, while in "World of Mines," food availability is limited and requires a thorough knowledge of the game rules and strategy. For those creators who are skilled, we encourage you to take on this challenge.

We hope you continue to enjoy "The Hundred Year Kingdom".
And, We look forward to hearing your comments and suggestions!

Cheers,
Waku Waku Games and Kaeru-san games.

notes.title: The Hundred Year Kingdom: Available 3 February 2022
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40995878/bf085120b9f80e886a5cd200a75c8b7176219909.png[/img]

Thank you for your patience. The release date of The Hundred Year Kingdom has now been set for 3 February 2022!

The Hundred Year Kingdom is a turn-based simulation game that lets you open up functional worlds in 6x6 grids and build unique civilizations over the course of a century (100 turns). Based on the ""expanded reproduction"" board game genre, players obtain assets by directing resources they start with to certain projects and areas, then harvesting and further investing assets to grow their world. Since it's up to the player to choose which structures and places to invest in to acquire maximum resources, the game requires a highly strategic approach.

Five goddesses (the girls shown on the left side of the screen) partner with the player to help build civilizations. Depending on which goddess you choose to be your partner per round, the buildings you can build will vary.

As you repeat turns and pass levels, new goddesses and maps will be unlocked and the game's worlds will further expand. In addition, goddesses can level up too. Every time you clear the game, goddesses get experience points and their levels rise, giving you certain advantages (like more initial resources). So with every new century, you can make even more progress, more smoothly. Enjoy creating civilizations over and over as you make history every 100 years with goddesses from around the world!

And, Delve into our additional materials to gain even more from the main game!

[b]The original soundtrack will be released at the same time as the game!
As will an art book![/b]

And (drumroll please)...
Check out the great value of [b]The Hundred Year Kingdom DX Bundle![/b]

This package includes the main game, the original soundtrack, and the art book as a set for a bargain price.

Thank you for checking out The Hundred Year Kingdom.

Please feel free to let us and others know your comments or feedback after playing via the Steam Community forum.

[i][b]Build legendary civilizations with the help of goddesses.[/b][/i]
The Hundred Year Kingdom, the turn-based simulation game that makes it easy to develop and nurture civilizations, is coming to Steam this winter. Together with a goddess of your choice, turn a pristine wilderness into a magnificent civilization within 100 years (100 turns). Challenge yourself by establishing a vast range of buildings and structures to improve your world's food production, resource utilization, and culture within the time limit to foster a peerless civilization that's all yours!

notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=fBaJDry__GY;full][/previewyoutube]
Check out the trailer introducing your trusty sidekicks, five different goddesses from throughout history. Each one has unique abilities and brings different potential creations to the table, shaping your civilization. They may also gift you different resources... but that's up to them! Grow your civilization over a century in a collaboration with these adorable, helpful girls.
